_description: CFDE-aligned ontology crosswalks for MoTrPAC PTM dashboard. Maps source-internal codes to standard vocabularies used by the CFDE Common Fund Data Ecosystem.

tissues._note: MoTrPAC tissue codes mapped to UBERON terms. Source organism is rat (NCBITaxon:10116); UBERON terms are species-neutral.

ptm_types._ontology: PSI-MOD (Proteomics Standards Initiative - Protein Modifications Ontology)
ptm_types._note: MoTrPAC assay codes mapped to PSI-MOD terms.

identifiers._note: Standard identifier namespaces used in the dashboard data.

data_source.name: MoTrPAC (Molecular Transducers of Physical Activity Consortium)

provenance.ortholog_mapping: RAT_TO_HUMAN_GENE and RAT_TO_HUMAN_PHOSPHO tables from MotrpacRatTraining6moData R package
provenance.uniprot_resolution: Human gene symbols resolved to reviewed Swiss-Prot accessions via UniProt REST API
provenance.statistical_model: Timewise differential analysis: logFC = trained vs. sedentary at each time point, per tissue and sex
limitations: Source R package fetched from main branch (no tagged releases available for version pinning)
Tissue-to-UBERON mappings added by this project, not provided by MoTrPAC source data
Ortholog mapping may miss proteins without clear one-to-one rat-to-human orthologs
Only training-regulated features (FDR < 0.05 in at least one comparison) are included

cfde_c2m2_alignment._note: How this dashboard's data model aligns with the CFDE Crosscut Metadata Model (C2M2).
cfde_c2m2_alignment.ptm_type: Maps to c2m2.ptm.modification_type using PSI-MOD terms
cfde_c2m2_alignment.anatomy: Maps to c2m2.anatomy using UBERON terms
cfde_c2m2_alignment.disease: Maps to c2m2.disease using DOID terms (in linked database, not dashboard)
